evidence_class: recorded replay of a live stream; the live capture itself (unsanitized) is private steward evidence under plans/evidence/2026-10-23-antigravity-onboarding/
cli_version_basis: discovered once per run by the documented adapter path `agy --version` before launch, because the stream-json output reports no version; the native session file was not consulted
mode_and_route: CliCapture launch (opt-in integration): raw stdout, independent byte copy, flush per record
capture_command: Do these steps in order using your tools, then answer. 1) View the file src/a.txt. 2) Run the shell command: cat src/b.txt 3) Write a new file src/out.txt containing exactly: hello journal. Finally reply with one line: done.
scenario: default request-review mode: a file read, then a run_command step that headless mode soft-denies (DONE with neither output nor error); the result reports SUCCESS, an empty response and denied_actions [{action: command, display_name: RunCommand}]

live_process.meaning: the CLI process outcome; distinct from storage finalization (recording.state) and acquisition extent (acquisition.status): EOF never implies success

sanitization: conversation id of the run -> stand-in 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000200
privacy_review: local paths (task directory, session scratch, home directory) and conversation ids (the run and any spawned subagent) replaced by text substitution on the raw bytes; tool names, step indexes, token counts, durations and the built-in tool list kept; prompt text is the deliberate synthetic task; reviewed 2026-10-23
